explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` to parse the fragment in BODY context, then walked tokens with `next_token()`. I appended decoded `#text` node contents via `get_modifiable_text()`, and also included `TITLE` and `TEXTAREA` opener text as documented special cases while naturally excluding `SCRIPT` and `STYLE`. Final output is truncated with `mb_substr(..., 'UTF-8')` to preserve whole code points.
